CustomField.description: This field will help determine which products should be targeted by marketing.
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Remove From List"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Open"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "House"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Pursuing"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Contacted"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Qualified/Converted"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Deferred"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Unqualified"), Do_Not_Solicit__c = True, Out_Of_Business__c = True, AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Do Not Solicit"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Do Not Solicit")))), "Do Not Solicit",
IF( AND( OR(OR(FICO_Score__c = 0, FICO_Score__c = -1, FICO_Score__c = 1, FICO_Score__c = Null, FICO_Score__c >= 575), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Interested"))), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Interested"))), "ALL",
IF( OR( AND( FICO_Score__c < 575, OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Qualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Interested"))), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Qualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Interested")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "")))), "Working Capital",
IF( AND( OR(FICO_Score__c = 0, FICO_Score__c = -1, FICO_Score__c = 1, FICO_Score__c = Null, FICO_Score__c >= 575), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Qualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Interested")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, ""))), "Lease",
IF( OR( AND( FICO_Score__c < 575, OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Qualified"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Interested"))), AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_Lease__c, "Not Qualified")), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Interested"), ISPICKVAL(Status_MCA__c, "Not Qualified")))), "Not Qualified - All","Sucka")))))
